description: This file defines the Api class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling Data Transfer Objects (DTO) related to API configurations in the installer/util V1 namespace. The class extends DataGroup and includes methods to create an instance from an array, as well as getters for API and module properties.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Represents an API DTO object with properties for API and module, extending DataGroup and including factory method for creating instances from array data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Api object with name, description, API, module, allowed permission, and permissions array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an Api instance from a data array, validating permissions.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Getter for the API string property.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Getter for the module string property.
